# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 15 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 34 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_015_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 15

**1** Jesus said: "When you see one who was not born of a woman, prostrate yourselves on your faces and worship him. That one is your Father."

---

**Translation Notes (LOGOS):**
- "Not born of a woman" — the defining negative; removes the being from the human order entirely
- "Prostrate yourselves on your faces" — the most extreme act of bodily worship; fuller than simply "worship"
- "That one is your Father" — identification made explicit; the un-born is the divine Father
- The saying implies: you may encounter such a one; the encounter demands total prostration
